subject: Hosted capacity uplift — onboarding sprint & live-rate handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina@shopverse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted capacity uplift — onboarding sprint & live-rate handoff

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our conversation, here's a concise plan to move ShopVerse from the current 2M monthly commit to the proposed 6M tier and ensure a smooth handoff to operations: 

Summary (ask):
- Increase monthly committed tokens from 2,000,000 to 6,000,000 starting July 1.
- Add a 10% burst pocket for the first 90 days for seasonal traffic testing.
- Maintain current SLA (99.95% uptime) and preserve soft-throttle thresholds for gradual stepping.

Attachments: ShopVerse_MAAP_v2.pdf (mutual action plan draft), commit_matrix_shopverse.xlsx (billing/rate matrix).

High-level milestones and owners:
1) Sign MAAP + PO (ShopVerse procurement) — target: 2029-05-28 — owner: Lina/Procurement
2) DocuSign + legal review (Redwood/ShopVerse) — target: 2029-05-30 — owner: Ben
3) Capacity provisioning & routing test (Redwood infra) — target: 2029-06-07 — owner: Naomi
4) Go-live smoke window (limited traffic) — 2029-06-10 to 2029-06-14 — owner: ShopVerse + Redwood on-call
5) Full cutover to 6M commit — 2029-07-01 — owner: mutual

Operational notes:
- We'll enable prefix KV caching for your high-frequency templates to reduce unit cost during the first 30 days.
- Default throttle tiers will be applied; if ShopVerse requires a higher 95th-percentile latency guard, we can model a custom lane (Ben - see pricing below).

Can you confirm the PO timeline and whether procurement needs an updated SOW? Once we have a signed MAAP and PO, Ben will send the DocuSign with the final commit amendment and new invoice cadence.

Thanks — I'll loop in the relevant ops folks after confirmation.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: ShopVerse_MAAP_v2.pdf] [Attachment: commit_matrix_shopverse.xlsx]

From: Lina Park <lina@shopverse.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, ShopVerse Procurement <procurement@shopverse.com>
Date: 2029-05-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — onboarding sprint & live-rate handoff

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from procurement and engineering: 

1) Procurement asks whether the 10% burst pocket is billable beyond the commit or is treated as a free trial for the first 90 days. Please confirm the overage policy.
2) Engineering wants clarification on the rate tiers when the KV cache is applied vs. cache-miss. Can you include an expected per-1k-token delta?
3) We also need a short security checklist for the DocuSign (SOC2 scope + retention terms) to share with our legal/compliance team.

If those items are in the MAAP, great — otherwise, can Ben send a short pricing appendix + a security addendum? We'll aim to have the PO ready by 2029-05-28 but may need a one-day extension if legal requests redlines.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of Product, ShopVerse
lina@shopverse.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina@shopverse.com>, ShopVerse Procurement <procurement@shopverse.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-21T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — onboarding sprint & live-rate handoff

Hi Lina —

Quick pricing and legal notes to address your items: 

Pricing (draft, for PO):
- Committed tier (6M tokens/month): $0.48 per 1k tokens effective July 1.
- 10% burst pocket (first 90 days): free; overage beyond burst pocket billed at $0.56 per 1k.
- Cache-effective delta: with prefix KV caching expected to reduce billing tokens ~18-25% depending on template reuse; we model conservatively at 18% for quarter-one.

Legal & compliance:
- I've attached the MAAP v2 which includes a short security addendum referencing SOC 2 in-scope systems and a 13-month retention profile by default. If ShopVerse needs 24-month retention, that is possible but may affect pricing (call out if required).
- DocuSign link for the commit amendment: https://pay.redwood.ai/docsign/DL-8543 (expires 2029-05-31).

Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears starting 2029-07-31 for July usage; we can do net-30 or net-45 depending on procurement preference.

Action items (Ben):
- Finalize DocuSign bundle + pricing appendix (target: 2029-05-24).
- Work with Naomi to confirm provisioning window and runbook (target: 2029-06-05).

If procurement agrees with the burst pocket being free for 90 days, we'll reflect that in the DocuSign and MAAP.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

[Attachment: ShopVerse_MAAP_v2.pdf]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina@shopverse.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-22T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — onboarding sprint & live-rate handoff

Hi team —

Operational readiness notes from infra/ops: 

1) Provisioning: We will reserve the pool for ShopVerse on 2029-06-01 and run routing tests the first week of June. Provisioning checklist attached to the internal runbook (I'll push to the console ops page).
2) Monitoring: We'll create a dashboard for token usage, average latency, 95th percentile latency, and error-rate by route. Link will be shared to your project workspace once the reservation is in place.
3) Fallback policy: If latency or error-rate breach our soft-throttle thresholds during the smoke window, we will automatically route to the secondary model variant (lower-memory quantized model) and notify on-call. This will be replayable for post-mortem.
4) On-call: Naomi (ops), Ben (SE), and Karthik (AM) will be in the go-live war room for the first 72 hours.

For the security checklist requested by Lina: our standard addendum covers SOC2 controls, key management (KMS), and audit log access via read-only exports. If ShopVerse needs an additional attestation, let procurement signal it and we can coordinate a short SOC2 evidence packet.

I'll mark internal tasks in the runbook and share the console link by 2029-05-24.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

We accept the 90-day free burst pocket as outlined. Please proceed with DocuSign and provisioning steps. We'll join the war room on June 10 for smoke tests.

— Lina
